items.stem: The main purpose of a discovery call is to:

options.text: Present the full product demo immediately
options.rationale: Demoing before discovery risks solving the wrong problem.

options.text: Understand the customer's problem, impact and decision process
options.rationale: Correct: discovery surfaces need, impact and how the decision is made.

options.text: Ask for the signature on the first call
options.rationale: Pushing to close before understanding the need is premature.
Price is not the point of discovery.

items.explanation: Correct: discovery surfaces need, impact and how the decision is made.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: An ideal customer profile (ICP) is most useful because it helps a seller:

options.text: Treat every company as equally likely to buy
options.rationale: An ICP does the opposite: it prioritises fit.

options.text: Focus effort on accounts most likely to succeed and buy
options.rationale: Correct: an ICP concentrates scarce selling time on best-fit accounts.

options.text: Avoid ever qualifying out a deal
options.rationale: An ICP supports qualifying out poor-fit deals.
Pricing is a separate decision from the ICP.

items.explanation: Correct: an ICP concentrates scarce selling time on best-fit accounts.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO are better first moves than discounting when you hit a price objection? (Select TWO)

options.text: Clarify the concern behind the objection
options.rationale: Correct: understanding the real concern often removes the need to discount.

options.text: Re-establish the value against the customer's cost of the problem
options.rationale: Correct: framing value against the problem's cost reframes price.

options.text: Immediately offer the largest available discount
options.rationale: Discounting first trains the buyer to push on price.

options.text: End the conversation to avoid the topic
options.rationale: Avoiding the objection does not resolve it.

items.explanation: Correct: understanding the real concern often removes the need to discount.; Correct: framing value against the problem's cost reframes price.
